compositors.name: picom
compositors.description: Shadows, fading, transparency and blur for any X11 desktop or window manager.

compositors.name: Built-in of the desktop (automatic)
compositors.description: The desktop's own compositor: xfwm4, KWin, Mutter, Marco, Muffin, Metacity, Budgie's or Enlightenment's.

compositors.name: xfwm4 (Xfce built-in)
compositors.description: Xfce's own window manager composites: shadows and transparency without picom.

compositors.name: KWin (KDE built-in)
compositors.description: KDE Plasma's own compositor. picom must not run next to it.

compositors.name: Mutter (GNOME built-in)
compositors.description: GNOME always composites with Mutter. picom must not run next to it.

compositors.name: Marco (MATE built-in)
compositors.description: MATE's own window manager composites (shadows, transparency).

compositors.name: Muffin (Cinnamon built-in)
compositors.description: Cinnamon always composites with Muffin. picom must not run next to it.

compositors.name: Budgie window manager (built-in)
compositors.description: Budgie always composites with its own window manager.

compositors.name: Metacity (GNOME Flashback built-in)
compositors.description: Metacity composites itself (shadows); picom is not needed.

compositors.name: Enlightenment built-in
compositors.description: Enlightenment always composites with its own engine. picom must not run next to it.

editions.name: Mini
editions.description: Only the desktop or window manager, a terminal and a file manager (no recommended packages).

editions.name: Compact
editions.description: The desktop with its core tools, network and settings, still without recommended packages.

editions.name: Full
editions.description: The complete desktop as Debian ships it (Debian task with recommended packages).

editions.name: Full with apps
editions.description: Full, plus the recommended applications for this desktop: browser, office, mail, media, graphics.
